I replied to Ilse in our direct message. I confirmed the new 7 July cutoff for the Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork and said I'd keep it private and take no action. I also asked them to confirm the year. 7 July has already passed this year, so I said I'm assuming 7 July 2027.

I searched GBrain for Quarrendon Freight Lines first and found nothing about this cutoff or anything that conflicts with it. The search ran on keywords only, so it could have missed notes worded differently.

I didn't save the date to GBrain, because that is a shared knowledge base and other people could read it there. I didn't share it anywhere else either.
